description: Perform a security audit on https://crawler-test.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider to identify insecure form implementations. STEPS: 1) Crawl the website. 2) Once complete, navigate to the 'Security' tab. 3) Use the filters to find 'Form on HTTP', 'Password Field on HTTP', or 'Insecure Form Action' issues. 4) Export the list of URLs with these security vulnerabilities to a CSV file in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/. SUCCESS CRITERIA: A CSV export containing at least one URL with a form security issue (e.g., non_secure_form URLs) from crawler-test.com.
